{{Quote|You are very brave human to come in here&hellip; I hope you are able to leave as quietly.|the Twi'lek majordomo, to Meetra Surik at the Jekk'Jekk Tarr|<ref name="KOTOR II" />|translated=1}}
A '''Twi'lek majordomo''' spent time at the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] Arid Room on<ref name="KOTOR II" /> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="KOTOR II" /> during the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="CAMP">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The Jekk'Jekk Tarr, located at the moon's [[Refugee Landing Pad|Refugee Docks]], catered to [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and was [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] to [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
While on the [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)|search]] for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zez-Kai Ell]], the Human [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]]<ref name="KOTOR II" /> [[Meetra Surik]]<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> entered the Jekk'Jekk Tarr and made<ref name="KOTOR II" /> her<ref name="Revan" /> way to the Arid Room. Surik initiated conversation with the Twi'lek, who thought she was brave for entering. The two eventually ended their conversation.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Don't play stupid with me. Tell me how to get to them, or you'll be drowning on your own screams.''"<br/>&laquo;''I could not help you&mdash;you must gain the attention of the Exchange first. Only then will their doors be open to you. It is not custom to attack in this place unless the owners permit it&mdash;I would advise you to keep a tight rein on your anger&hellip; if one blaster is drawn in here, then all blasters will be drawn.''&raquo;|An optional conversation between Meetra Surik and the majordomo|quoteend=0|<ref name="KOTOR II" />}}
The Twi'lek majordomo appeared in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. The character shares the same character model as [[Griff Vao]], a character who appeared in the [[2003]] prequel to ''The Sith Lords'',<ref name="KOTOR II" /> ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The conversations with the majordomo and the playable characters are optional and not required for game completion.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> This article assumes the conversation did happen, but does not assume what Surik and Mira said to the majordomo.

Surik can choose to ask the majordomo if the Exchange makes the Jekk'Jekk Tarr their lair. The Twi'lek will deny knowing anything about the topic but will tell her there is perhaps a high-ranking lounge in the cantina that is a lair of the Exchange, though it is only available through invite. Surik can respond to this to by telling them she will wait, or by threatening them for more information. To the waiting option, the Twi'lek will tell them she will not have to wait long with her attitude. To the threatening option, they will tell her they cannot help her and to wait and gain the Exchange's attention. The Twi'lek also adds that she should reign in her anger, lest she starts a fight between all cantina occupants.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

With Mira, the player can ask the majordomo how they know she is Human, to which the Twi'lek will point out her pressure suit and her walk. They then tell Mira to not worry, as they doubt the others in the Jekk'Jekk Tarr are knowledgeable enough on Human mannerisms to know she is Human. Mira can also tell them she is looking for Visquis, though they will state that, without his invitation, they cannot help. The Twi'lek will add, however, that Visquis allegedly has many chambers below the Jekk'Jekk Tarr.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
